hypothesis: Require the immediately adjacent second closed 15M candle to sustain the same first Shadow setup and strict confirmation. Enter only after this second close; freeze original 4H SL and measured extension. Independent strategy comparison, not a pure filter effect.
prospective_windows: Fixed seven-day UTC windows from Oct 8. Completed days only; no collection activation after a retrospective KILL. Separate samples from existing experiments.

rules.first_seed: First existing Shadow v2-qualified setup only, including setup identity, valid structural SL, retest, candle direction and close strictly beyond roll. First-seed fee-adjusted room need not already qualify; the second-close price is independently assessed.
rules.second_confirmation: Exactly the next contiguous CLOSED 15M bar. Same setup/direction and latest candle time; strict color AND close beyond the same roll, retest and current stop validity. Its whole bar must not touch the original frozen SL. Failure consumes the setup; no retries or later better confirmations.
rules.frozen_structure: First signal structural SL, roll and measured extension are immutable. No widened SL or new extension from a later 4H bar.
rules.entry_target: At second confirmation close freeze a limit at that close and a cost-adjusted net-2R TP computed from the original SL. TP must lie inside the original measured extension. Continuous hypothetical prices, not real orders.
rules.entry_clock: Second signal close +1ms. Neither first nor second confirmation candle can fill or decide a trade outcome. The second bar SL check is pre-entry invalidation only, never an SL outcome.
rules.execution: Reuse frozen confirmation-zone evaluator with pure model-name adapter. Only later closed bars, same setup and strict latest closed confirmation/structure before fills, four-bar expiry, opening through original roll/stop rejects.
rules.outcomes: Any exit touch on unknown intrabar limit-fill bar = AMBIGUOUS; no fill-bar excursions. Later TP+SL same candle = AMBIGUOUS, gaps stop, stop opening gaps charged at worse open. No inferred ordering.
rules.boundary: First seeds whose adjacent second close is outside the source period are censored/excluded, never silently reassigned to the next weekly cohort. Partial-week updates may complete them before the fixed week ends.
rules.identity: Exactly one second-confirmation chance per first setup; source warmup excludes prior setups. Never count retries or tickers as new setups.

portfolio.quantity: reserve at creation using net stop risk and known cash; round observed size step; no future profit increases
portfolio.uncertain: freeze capital on ambiguous result/gap; equity and ROI unknown

decision.kill: Any sufficiently sampled retrospective period net AvgR<=0 or PF<=1: KILL and do not activate forward collection.
decision.insufficient: CONTINUE_INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE; retain all rules; no promotion.
decision.retrospective_pass: Both fixed periods >=20 resolved, AvgR>0, PF>1 and net additional filled setups vs current >0: FORWARD_SHADOW_REQUIRED.
decision.forward: Only complete future registered windows with >=20 resolved, positive net AvgR, PF>1, net incremental fills and cost/capital review can justify manual production consideration. No automatic promotion.
decision.roi: Report realized cash separately; OPEN/AMBIGUOUS/data gaps keep equity and full ROI unknown.

comparison: Preserve all four original model ledgers, metrics and independent capped portfolios. Compare setup overlap/missing/new fills, net fill difference vs current and first-confirmation net2R. Entry time/price/TP differ, so no causal paired-filter or improved-return claim from count changes.
limitations: Retrospective periods already viewed; no untouched validation claim.
Extra price touches are not live fills; conservative OHLC ambiguity may censor outcomes.
Cost-adjusted net risk R differs from original Shadow price-stop R.
No condition tuning after viewing this experiment. Existing frozen strategy protocols and live signals remain unchanged.
Confirmation persistence may reduce entries or delay price; exact OHLC fills, exchange tick, funding and liquidity unvalidated.
No reclassification of rejected earlier model, no subgroup tuning. Unresolved positions retain unknown whole-cohort equity/ROI.
